name: mote-stage-desktop
description: Offline theater avatar with microphone and webcam puppetry
author: MOTE Stage

scripts.check: node scripts/check.mjs && node checks/stage-link.mjs && node checks/face-geometry.mjs && node checks/post-processing.mjs && node checks/performance.mjs && node checks/appearance.mjs && node checks/appearance-ui.mjs && node checks/glass-optics.mjs && node checks/actor-actions.mjs && node checks/surface-animation.mjs && node checks/mouth-pose.mjs && node checks/actor-calibration.mjs && node checks/calibration-ui.mjs && node checks/head-motion.mjs && node checks/action-surface.mjs && node checks/background.mjs && node checks/glass-frosting.mjs && node checks/media-input.mjs && node checks/action-body.mjs && node checks/character-performance.mjs && node checks/surface-frame.mjs && node checks/facial-animation.mjs && node checks/show-clock.mjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run check && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Animate the avatar using local webcam head and face tracking.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Animate the avatar using local microphone input.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Send the audience video to NDI receivers on your local network when NDI output is enabled.
